d:
Get ready to party with the ultimate dance anthem “Saturday Saturday” from Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania! Featuring the electrifying chemistry of Varun Dhawan and Alia Bhatt, this high-energy track became an instant favourite for every celebration.
Credits:
Song: Saturday Saturday
Movie: Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania
Singers: Indeep Bakshi, Akriti Kakkar, Badshah
Lyrics: Kumaar, Badshah
Music: Sharib Toshi, Badshah & Titans
Director: Shashank Khaitan
